lines.text: The LORD answers Job out of the whirlwind and tells him to brace himself like a man.
The LORD asks Job where he was when He laid the foundations of the heavens.
The LORD says He fixed the sea's boundaries and told its proud waves to stop at a set place.
The LORD asks if Job has journeyed to the cave of Machpelah or seen the gates of death.
The LORD sends rain on a desert where no man lives to make the parched wasteland sprout tender grass.
